title: SCHC durable floors can alias a new key generation through Python object-id reuse
description: _AuthenticatedReassemblyManager keys generation-scoped state with id(key_generation). Active/tombstone rows retain the token object, but durable _floors retain only the integer ID. After revocation removes the generation mapping and the token is garbage-collected, Python may reuse that ID for a later generation; the stale-floor purge then mistakes the new generation for the old one. Key state by the opaque generation object itself (identity token), retaining it for the floor lifetime, and add a deterministic regression that demonstrates distinct same-pubkey generations never alias.
